summary: Verified admin sign-in bug fix on preview URL. Backend /api/auth/login returns 200 for both clean 'admin@onestock.in' and messy '  Admin@OneStock.IN  ' (leading/trailing spaces + uppercase). Frontend E2E: Get Started -> AuthModal -> admin login lands on panel with 'Hello, Admin' greeting, 'Welcome back, Admin' toast, and Users nav item visible in sidebar. Users page lists admin@onestock.in and test@onestock.in. Messy-input login also succeeded end-to-end. Normal user login (test@onestock.in / Test@12345) works and correctly does NOT show Users nav (role gating). No wrong-password attempts were made against admin (to avoid lockout).

issues: Recharts warnings: chart container width/height reported as -1 during initial mount (harmless but noisy); consider setting min-width/min-height on ResponsiveContainer parent.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py login lockout is email-keyed (correct for k8s ingress) but there is no admin-safe backoff — 5 wrong attempts locks the real admin for 15 min. Consider exempting the seeded admin from lockout or adding an IP+email compound key.
Multiple 401s observed in console before login is expected (/api/auth/me probes) — could be silenced by treating 401 as unauthenticated state without logging error.
seed_data_creation: None. No throwaway uitest_ accounts created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'not able to sign in as admin' is resolved. Email is normalized via .strip().lower() on backend (register/login/forgot-password) and frontend AuthModal trims before submit. Verified against preview URL https://tradesense-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Do NOT attempt >4 wrong passwords on admin@onestock.in — email-keyed 15 min lockout.
rca of the issue: Original report was likely caused by (a) transient service-restart window during concurrent work, and/or (b) mobile keyboards inserting a trailing space / capitalizing the first letter of the email. Fix: backend normalizes body.email.strip().lower() in login/register/forgot-password; frontend AuthModal trims email/name before POST. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login with '  Admin@OneStock.IN  ' + correct password -> 200 with role=admin. UI repro on preview URL also passes: greeting 'Hello, Admin', Users nav visible, users list contains admin + test user.
